prompt:
We're launching a new subcategory page for our PawPerfect pet supplies store — specifically for dog shampoos and conditioners under our grooming section. Our SEO team flagged a bunch of problems in seo/audits/2023_audit_notes.txt and the raw catalog data is in catalog_spec.json at the root of the workspace.

We need a complete, production-ready specification for this page that our dev team can implement. Please create a file named category_page_spec.json that covers everything: the corrected page URL, the page hierarchy from homepage to this category, the H1, title, meta description, the actual category intro copy (not a placeholder — write the real thing), a FAQ section, how we should handle all the filter/facet URLs so we don't get penalized by Google, and the structured data markup our developers should add.

The audit notes and crawl data show several things that need to be fixed. Make sure the spec reflects a properly optimized state, not the current broken one.
